data.gender_notes: Phoenix is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Phoenix is recorded in name-lists as “Rising from the ashes”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Phoenix expresses “Rising from the ashes”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Phoenix total 46, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

in_latin.name: Phoenix
in_latin.long_meaning: Phoenix est nomen avium quae per ignem resurgunt. Per aeternitatem renascuntur et perpetuo vivunt. In mythology antiqua, Phoenix est auctor mythorum de resurrectione et vita aeterna.
